# Generated. One shared record per model and price. The earliest seller of that price is paid when a buyer takes a lot.

dd_clear_listings = {
	set_temp_variable = { dd_i = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_i < 96 } }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_idx^dd_i = -1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_amt^dd_i = 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { dd_i = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { dd_i = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_i < 128 } }
		set_variable = { global.dd_lot_qty^dd_i = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_lot_list^dd_i = -1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_lot_seq^dd_i = 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { dd_i = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.dd_lot_next = 1 }
}

# Merge into the record with this model and price, or open a new one.
dd_post_listing = {
	set_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.dd_post_at = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { dd_i = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { dd_found = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { dd_empty = -1 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { dd_i < 96 }
			check_variable = { dd_found < 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_pr = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_q = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_q > 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_post_cat }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_post_idx }
				check_variable = { dd_pr = global.dd_post_price }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { dd_found = dd_i }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_empty < 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_q < 1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { dd_empty = dd_i }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { dd_i = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_found > -1 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_found = global.dd_post_qty }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_at = dd_found }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_empty > -1 } }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_empty = global.dd_post_cat }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_idx^dd_empty = global.dd_post_idx }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_empty = global.dd_post_price }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_empty = global.dd_post_qty }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_amt^dd_empty = global.dd_post_amt }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_at = dd_empty }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 }
	}
}

# Undo the listing add when the seller queue cannot take another claim.
dd_unpost_lot = {
	set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_post_at }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_post_qty }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_idx^dd_i = -1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_list_amt^dd_i = 0 }
	}
}

# Remember who sold this lot. Same country selling again at the same price extends their latest claim.
dd_enqueue_seller = {
	set_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.dd_pay_best = -1 }
	set_variable = { global.dd_lot_empty = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { dd_tail_seq = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { dd_i = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_i < 128 } }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_q = global.dd_lot_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_list = global.dd_lot_list^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_seq = global.dd_lot_seq^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_q > 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_list = global.dd_post_at }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { dd_seq > dd_tail_seq } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_best = dd_i }
				set_temp_variable = { dd_tail_seq = dd_seq }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.dd_lot_empty < 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_q < 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_lot_empty = dd_i }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { dd_i = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.dd_same_seller = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_pay_best > -1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_best = global.dd_pay_best }
		set_variable = { global.dd_pay_who = global.dd_lot_who^dd_best }
		var:global.dd_pay_who = {
			if = {
				limit = { tag = ROOT }
				set_variable = { global.dd_same_seller = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_same_seller = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_best = global.dd_pay_best }
		add_to_variable = { global.dd_lot_qty^dd_best = global.dd_post_qty }
		set_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_lot_empty > -1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_empty = global.dd_lot_empty }
		set_variable = { global.dd_lot_list^dd_empty = global.dd_post_at }
		set_variable = { global.dd_lot_qty^dd_empty = global.dd_post_qty }
		set_variable = { global.dd_lot_seq^dd_empty = global.dd_lot_next }
		set_variable = { global.dd_lot_who^dd_empty = THIS }
		add_to_variable = { global.dd_lot_next = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 }
	}
}

# Pay the oldest seller of global.dd_active_list one lot.
# A dead seller's lot is still consumed. That cash is not paid to anyone.
# Starting stock has no seller, so that cash is not paid either.
dd_pay_front_seller = {
	set_variable = { global.dd_paid = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.dd_pay_guard = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.dd_paid = 0 }
			check_variable = { global.dd_pay_guard < 128 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.dd_pay_guard = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_pay_best = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_best_seq = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { dd_i < 128 } }
			set_temp_variable = { dd_q = global.dd_lot_qty^dd_i }
			set_temp_variable = { dd_list = global.dd_lot_list^dd_i }
			set_temp_variable = { dd_seq = global.dd_lot_seq^dd_i }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { dd_q > 0 }
					check_variable = { dd_list = global.dd_active_list }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_pay_best < 0 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_pay_best = dd_i }
					set_temp_variable = { dd_best_seq = dd_seq }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { dd_seq < dd_best_seq } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_pay_best = dd_i }
					set_temp_variable = { dd_best_seq = dd_seq }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { dd_i = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_pay_best < 0 } }
			set_variable = { global.dd_paid = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { dd_best = global.dd_pay_best }
			set_temp_variable = { dd_list = global.dd_active_list }
			set_variable = { global.dd_sale_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_list }
			set_variable = { global.dd_sale_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_list }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_who = global.dd_lot_who^dd_best }
			set_variable = { global.dd_seller_alive = 0 }
			var:global.dd_pay_who = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					set_variable = { global.dd_seller_alive = 1 }
					add_to_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_amt }
					set_variable = { dd_sale_paid = global.dd_pay_amt }
					set_variable = { dd_sale_cat = global.dd_sale_cat }
					set_variable = { dd_sale_idx = global.dd_sale_idx }
					country_event = { id = doomsday_market.1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { dd_best = global.dd_pay_best }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_lot_qty^dd_best = global.dd_pay_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_paid = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { dd_q = global.dd_lot_qty^dd_best }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { dd_q < 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_lot_qty^dd_best = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_lot_list^dd_best = -1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_lot_seq^dd_best = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Floor of global.dd_div_n / global.dd_div_d. Result is global.dd_div_q.
dd_floor_div = {
	set_temp_variable = { dd_q = global.dd_div_n }
	divide_temp_variable = { dd_q = global.dd_div_d }
	round_temp_variable = dd_q
	set_temp_variable = { dd_cost = dd_q }
	multiply_temp_variable = { dd_cost = global.dd_div_d }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_n < dd_cost } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { dd_q = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_q < 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_q = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.dd_div_q = dd_q }
}

# Pay global.dd_bulk_lots of the active listing. One popup per seller, for the whole sum.
# Lots with no living seller are still delivered. That cash is not paid to anyone.
dd_pay_bulk = {
	set_temp_variable = { dd_list = global.dd_active_list }
	set_variable = { global.dd_sale_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_list }
	set_variable = { global.dd_sale_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_list }
	set_variable = { global.dd_pay_guard = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.dd_pay_guard < 128 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.dd_pay_guard = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_pay_best = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_best_seq = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { dd_i < 128 } }
			set_temp_variable = { dd_q = global.dd_lot_qty^dd_i }
			set_temp_variable = { dd_list = global.dd_lot_list^dd_i }
			set_temp_variable = { dd_seq = global.dd_lot_seq^dd_i }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { dd_q > 0 }
					check_variable = { dd_list = global.dd_active_list }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_pay_best < 0 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_pay_best = dd_i }
					set_temp_variable = { dd_best_seq = dd_seq }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { dd_seq < dd_best_seq } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_pay_best = dd_i }
					set_temp_variable = { dd_best_seq = dd_seq }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { dd_i = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_pay_best < 0 } }
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { dd_best = global.dd_pay_best }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_lot_qty^dd_best }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_qty }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_take = global.dd_div_q }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_pay_take > global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_take = global.dd_bulk_lots }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_pay_take < 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_lot_qty^dd_best = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_lot_list^dd_best = -1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_lot_seq^dd_best = 0 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { global.dd_sale_sum = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_sale_sum = global.dd_pay_take }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_take }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_who = global.dd_lot_who^dd_best }
				var:global.dd_pay_who = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						add_to_variable = { treasury = global.dd_sale_sum }
						set_variable = { dd_sale_paid = global.dd_sale_sum }
						set_variable = { dd_sale_cat = global.dd_sale_cat }
						set_variable = { dd_sale_idx = global.dd_sale_idx }
						country_event = { id = doomsday_market.1 }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { dd_best = global.dd_pay_best }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_lot_qty^dd_best = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_pay_take }
				set_temp_variable = { dd_q = global.dd_lot_qty^dd_best }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { dd_q < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_lot_qty^dd_best = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_lot_list^dd_best = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_lot_seq^dd_best = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

dd_buy_all_amphibious_mechanized_eq_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_amphibious_mechanized_eq_1 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_amphibious_mechanized_eq_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_amphibious_mechanized_eq_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = amphibious_mechanized_equipment_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_amphibious_mechanized_eq_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_amphibious_mechanized_eq_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_amphibious_mechanized_eq_1 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { amphibious_mechanized_equipment_1 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_amphibious_mechanized_eq_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@amphibious_mechanized_equipment_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_amphibious_mechanized_eq_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = amphibious_mechanized_equipment_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_amphibious_mechanized_eq_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }

				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }

dd_sell_all_amphibious_tank_chassis_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_amphibious_tank_chassis_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_amphibious_tank_chassis_1 = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { amphibious_tank_chassis_1 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_amphibious_tank_chassis_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@amphibious_tank_chassis_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_amphibious_tank_chassis_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = amphibious_tank_chassis_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_amphibious_tank_chassis_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { anti_air_equipment_2 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@anti_air_equipment_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 4 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = anti_air_equipment_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_anti_air_eq_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_anti_air_eq_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { anti_air_equipment_2 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 4 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = 20 }
		dd_post_listing = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
			dd_enqueue_seller = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = anti_air_equipment_2
					amount = -20
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_anti_air_eq_2 = 20 }
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
			else = {
				dd_unpost_lot = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

dd_ask_up_anti_air_eq_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { anti_air_equipment_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 < 999 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 = 1 }
		dd_refresh_buy_slots = yes
	}
}

dd_ask_down_anti_air_eq_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { anti_air_equipment_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 > 1 }
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { dd_my_ask_anti_air_eq_2 = 1 }
		dd_refresh_buy_slots = yes
	}
}

dd_buy_all_anti_air_eq_3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 5 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_anti_air_eq_3 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_anti_air_eq_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_anti_air_eq_3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = anti_air_equipment_3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_anti_air_eq_3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }

dd_sell_all_sam_eq_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_sam_eq_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_sam_eq_1 = 16 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { sam_equipment_1 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_sam_eq_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@sam_equipment_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_sam_eq_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = sam_equipment_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_sam_eq_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_spaa_eq_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 10 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_spaa_eq_2 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_spaa_eq_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_spaa_eq_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = spaa_equipment_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_shorad_eq_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_shorad_eq_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_shorad_eq_2 = 13 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { shorad_equipment_2 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_shorad_eq_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@shorad_equipment_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 12 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_shorad_eq_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = shorad_equipment_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_shorad_eq_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_spaa_eq_3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 13 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_spaa_eq_3 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_spaa_eq_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_spaa_eq_3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = spaa_equipment_3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_sam_eq_3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 15 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_sam_eq_3 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_sam_eq_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_sam_eq_3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = sam_equipment_3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_sam_eq_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_sam_eq_3 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_sam_eq_3 = 19 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { sam_equipment_3 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_sam_eq_3 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@sam_equipment_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 15 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_sam_eq_3 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = sam_equipment_3
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_sam_eq_3 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_sam_eq_4 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 18 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_sam_eq_4 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_sam_eq_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_sam_eq_4 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = sam_equipment_4
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}

dd_sell_all_ifpc_eq_1 = {

		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ifpc_eq_1 = 18 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ifpc_equipment_1 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ifpc_eq_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ifpc_equipment_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ifpc_eq_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = ifpc_equipment_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ifpc_eq_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_anti_tank_eq_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 23 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_anti_tank_eq_2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_anti_tank_eq_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_anti_tank_eq_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = anti_tank_equipment_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_infantry_at_eq_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 28 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_at_eq_2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_infantry_at_eq_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_at_eq_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_at_equipment_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_infantry_at_eq_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_at_eq_3 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_at_eq_3 = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { infantry_at_equipment_3 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_at_eq_3 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@infantry_at_equipment_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 30 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_infantry_at_eq_3 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = infantry_at_equipment_3
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_at_eq_3 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_td_eq_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 31 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_td_eq_2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_td_eq_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_td_eq_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = td_equipment_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_infantry_at_eq_4 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 33 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_at_eq_4 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_infantry_at_eq_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_at_eq_4 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_at_equipment_4
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { infantry_at_equipment_4 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_at_eq_4 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@infantry_at_equipment_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 33 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_infantry_at_eq_4 }

				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = infantry_at_equipment_4
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_at_eq_4 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}

dd_sell_all_infantry_at_eq_5 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_at_eq_5 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_at_eq_5 = 9 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { infantry_at_equipment_5 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_at_eq_5 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@infantry_at_equipment_5 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 35 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_infantry_at_eq_5 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = infantry_at_equipment_5
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_at_eq_5 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_td_eq_4 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 36 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_td_eq_4 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_td_eq_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_td_eq_4 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = td_equipment_4
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_infantry_at_eq_8 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 41 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_at_eq_8 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_infantry_at_eq_8 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_at_eq_8 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_at_equipment_8
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }

			dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
		}

dd_sell_all_armored_car_eq_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_armored_car_eq_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_armored_car_eq_1 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { armored_car_equipment_1 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_armored_car_eq_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@armored_car_equipment_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 43 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_armored_car_eq_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = armored_car_equipment_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_armored_car_eq_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }

				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 45 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_armored_car_eq_2 }

						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = armored_car_equipment_2

dd_buy_all_armored_support_vehicle_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 46 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_armored_support_vehicle_1 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_armored_support_vehicle_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_armored_support_vehicle_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = armored_support_vehicle_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_artillery_eq_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_artillery_eq_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_artillery_eq_2 = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { artillery_equipment_2 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_artillery_eq_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@artillery_equipment_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 48 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_artillery_eq_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = artillery_equipment_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_artillery_eq_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_mortar_eq_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 51 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_mortar_eq_1 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_mortar_eq_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_mortar_eq_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = mortar_equipment_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_artillery_eq_cw2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_artillery_eq_cw2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_artillery_eq_cw2 = 11 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { artillery_equipment_cw2 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_artillery_eq_cw2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@artillery_equipment_cw2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 53 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_artillery_eq_cw2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = artillery_equipment_cw2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_artillery_eq_cw2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_mortar_eq_3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 54 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_mortar_eq_3 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_mortar_eq_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_mortar_eq_3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = mortar_equipment_3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 56 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_artillery_eq_cw4 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_artillery_eq_cw4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_artillery_eq_cw4 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = artillery_equipment_cw4
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes

		}

dd_buy_all_dew_eq_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 59 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_dew_eq_2 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_dew_eq_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_dew_eq_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = dew_equipment_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}

			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }

				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_hpm_eq_1 = global.dd_pay_units }

dd_sell_all_hpm_eq_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_hpm_eq_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_hpm_eq_1 = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { hpm_equipment_1 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_hpm_eq_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@hpm_equipment_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 61 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_hpm_eq_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = hpm_equipment_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_hpm_eq_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}
