dd_buy_all_heavy_tank_chassis_0 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 64 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_heavy_tank_chassis_0 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_heavy_tank_chassis_0 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_heavy_tank_chassis_0 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = heavy_tank_chassis_0
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_heavy_tank_chassis_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_heavy_tank_chassis_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_heavy_tank_chassis_2 = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { heavy_tank_chassis_2 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_heavy_tank_chassis_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@heavy_tank_chassis_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 66 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_heavy_tank_chassis_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = heavy_tank_chassis_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_heavy_tank_chassis_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_attack_heli_eq_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 69 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_attack_heli_eq_1 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_attack_heli_eq_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_attack_heli_eq_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = attack_heli_equipment_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_0 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_0 = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { infantry_equipment_0 > 99 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_0 > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 73 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_0 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 100 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = 100 }
		dd_post_listing = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
			dd_enqueue_seller = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_equipment_0
					amount = -100
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_0 = 100 }
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
			else = {
				dd_unpost_lot = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

dd_ask_up_infantry_eq_0 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { infantry_equipment_0 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_0 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_0 < 999 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_0 = 1 }
		dd_refresh_buy_slots = yes
	}
}

dd_ask_down_infantry_eq_0 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { infantry_equipment_0 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_0 > 1 }
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_0 = 1 }
		dd_refresh_buy_slots = yes
	}
}

dd_buy_all_infantry_eq_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 74 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 99 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_1 > 99 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_equipment_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_infantry_eq_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 74 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 99 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_1 > 99 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { treasury = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 100 }
			dd_pay_front_seller = yes
			set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 100 }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_1 = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment_1
				amount = 100
				producer = ROOT
			}
			dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
			dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
		}
}

dd_sell_all_infantry_eq_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_1 = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { infantry_equipment_1 > 99 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@infantry_equipment_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 74 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = infantry_equipment_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_infantry_eq_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_3 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_3 = 8 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { infantry_equipment_3 > 99 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_3 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@infantry_equipment_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 76 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_3 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = infantry_equipment_3
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_3 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_infantry_eq_cw1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 77 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 99 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw1 > 99 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_equipment_cw1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_infantry_eq_cw3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 79 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 99 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw3 > 99 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_equipment_cw3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_infantry_eq_cw3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }

			set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }

			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw3 = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment_cw3
				amount = 100
				producer = ROOT
			}
			dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
			dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
		}
}

dd_sell_all_infantry_eq_cw3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw3 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw3 = 11 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { infantry_equipment_cw3 > 99 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw3 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@infantry_equipment_cw3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 79 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw3 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = infantry_equipment_cw3
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw3 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw3 < 1 } }

dd_sell_all_infantry_eq_cw5 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw5 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw5 = 13 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { infantry_equipment_cw5 > 99 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw5 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@infantry_equipment_cw5 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 81 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw5 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = infantry_equipment_cw5
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw5 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}

						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_infantry_eq_cw6 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 82 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 99 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw6 > 99 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw6 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw6 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_equipment_cw6
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 84 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 99 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw8 > 99 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw8 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw8 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_equipment_cw8
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_infantry_eq_cw8 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }

			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 84 }

				check_variable = { dd_qty > 99 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw8 > 99 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { treasury = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 100 }
			dd_pay_front_seller = yes
			set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 100 }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw8 = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment_cw8
				amount = 100
				producer = ROOT
			}
			dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
			dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
		}
}

dd_sell_all_infantry_eq_cw8 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw8 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw8 = 21 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { infantry_equipment_cw8 > 99 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw8 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@infantry_equipment_cw8 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 84 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_infantry_eq_cw8 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = infantry_equipment_cw8
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_infantry_eq_cw8 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 85 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_land_cruiser_chassis_1 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_land_cruiser_chassis_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }

				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_land_cruiser_chassis_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {

dd_buy_all_light_tank_chassis_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 87 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_tank_chassis_1 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_light_tank_chassis_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_tank_chassis_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = light_tank_chassis_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_light_tank_chassis_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_tank_chassis_3 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_tank_chassis_3 = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { light_tank_chassis_3 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_tank_chassis_3 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@light_tank_chassis_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 89 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_light_tank_chassis_3 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = light_tank_chassis_3
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_tank_chassis_3 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_light_tank_eq_cw3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 92 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_tank_eq_cw3 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_light_tank_eq_cw3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_tank_eq_cw3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = light_tank_equipment_cw3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 94 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_tank_eq_cw5 > 9 }
			}

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_light_tank_eq_cw5 }

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }

				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_tank_eq_cw5 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }

dd_sell_all_light_tank_eq_cw5 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_tank_eq_cw5 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_tank_eq_cw5 = 9 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { light_tank_equipment_cw5 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_tank_eq_cw5 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@light_tank_equipment_cw5 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 94 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_light_tank_eq_cw5 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = light_tank_equipment_cw5
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_tank_eq_cw5 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

	if = {

		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_tank_eq_cw7 = 11 }
	}

		limit = {
			has_equipment = { light_tank_equipment_cw7 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_tank_eq_cw7 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@light_tank_equipment_cw7 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }

				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 96 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_light_tank_eq_cw7 }

dd_buy_all_manpads_eq_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 97 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_manpads_eq_1 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_manpads_eq_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_manpads_eq_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = manpads_equipment_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_manpads_eq_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_manpads_eq_3 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_manpads_eq_3 = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { manpads_equipment_3 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_manpads_eq_3 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@manpads_equipment_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 99 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_manpads_eq_3 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = manpads_equipment_3
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_manpads_eq_3 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_mechanized_eq_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 102 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_mechanized_eq_2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_mechanized_eq_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_mechanized_eq_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = mechanized_equipment_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_mechanized_eq_4 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_mechanized_eq_4 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_mechanized_eq_4 = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { mechanized_equipment_4 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_mechanized_eq_4 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@mechanized_equipment_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 104 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_mechanized_eq_4 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = mechanized_equipment_4
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_mechanized_eq_4 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_medium_tank_chassis_0 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 107 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_medium_tank_chassis_0 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_medium_tank_chassis_0 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_medium_tank_chassis_0 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = medium_tank_chassis_0
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { medium_tank_chassis_2 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_medium_tank_chassis_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@medium_tank_chassis_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 109 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_medium_tank_chassis_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }

						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {

						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes

dd_buy_all_medium_tank_chassis_3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 110 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_medium_tank_chassis_3 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_medium_tank_chassis_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_medium_tank_chassis_3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = medium_tank_chassis_3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_mbt_eq_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 112 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_mbt_eq_1 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_mbt_eq_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_mbt_eq_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = mbt_equipment_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_mbt_eq_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_mbt_eq_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_mbt_eq_1 = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { mbt_equipment_1 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_mbt_eq_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@mbt_equipment_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 112 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_mbt_eq_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = mbt_equipment_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_mbt_eq_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_mbt_eq_4 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 115 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_mbt_eq_4 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_mbt_eq_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_mbt_eq_4 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = mbt_equipment_4
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 117 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_mbt_eq_6 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_mbt_eq_6 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_mbt_eq_6 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = mbt_equipment_6
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}

		}

dd_sell_all_mbt_eq_6 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_mbt_eq_6 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_mbt_eq_6 = 9 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { mbt_equipment_6 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_mbt_eq_6 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@mbt_equipment_6 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 117 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_mbt_eq_6 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = mbt_equipment_6
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_mbt_eq_6 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {

				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }

			has_equipment = { motorized_equipment_0 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_motorized_eq_0 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@motorized_equipment_0 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 122 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_motorized_eq_0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = motorized_equipment_0
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_motorized_eq_0 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_motorized_eq_3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 125 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_motorized_eq_3 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_motorized_eq_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_motorized_eq_3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = motorized_equipment_3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_motorized_rocket_eq_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_motorized_rocket_eq_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_motorized_rocket_eq_1 = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { motorized_rocket_equipment_1 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_motorized_rocket_eq_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@motorized_rocket_equipment_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 127 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_motorized_rocket_eq_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = motorized_rocket_equipment_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_motorized_rocket_eq_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {

					}
				}
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_prsm_eq_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 128 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_prsm_eq_1 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_prsm_eq_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_prsm_eq_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = prsm_equipment_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}
