dd_buy_all_rocket_artillery_eq_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 133 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_rocket_artillery_eq_2 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_rocket_artillery_eq_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_rocket_artillery_eq_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = rocket_artillery_equipment_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_spg_eq_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 138 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_spg_eq_1 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_spg_eq_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_spg_eq_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = spg_equipment_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_spg_eq_3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 140 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_spg_eq_3 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_spg_eq_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_spg_eq_3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = spg_equipment_3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_spg_eq_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_spg_eq_3 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_spg_eq_3 = 11 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { spg_equipment_3 > 19 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_spg_eq_3 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@spg_equipment_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 140 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_spg_eq_3 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = spg_equipment_3
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_spg_eq_3 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_spg_eq_6 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 143 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 19 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_spg_eq_6 > 19 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_spg_eq_6 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 20 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 20 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_spg_eq_6 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = spg_equipment_6
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_support_eq_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 148 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 99 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_support_eq_1 > 99 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_support_eq_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_support_eq_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = support_equipment_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_support_eq_cw2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_support_eq_cw2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_support_eq_cw2 = 20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { support_equipment_cw2 > 99 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_support_eq_cw2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@support_equipment_cw2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 150 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_support_eq_cw2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = support_equipment_cw2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_support_eq_cw2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_support_eq_cw5 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 0 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 153 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 99 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_support_eq_cw5 > 99 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_support_eq_cw5 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 100 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 100 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_support_eq_cw5 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = support_equipment_cw5
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

			limit = {

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {

dd_buy_all_ballistic_missile_eq_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ballistic_missile_eq_2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ballistic_missile_eq_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ballistic_missile_eq_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ballistic_missile_equipment_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_ballistic_missile_eq_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ballistic_missile_eq_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ballistic_missile_eq_2 = 15 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ballistic_missile_equipment_2 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ballistic_missile_eq_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ballistic_missile_equipment_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ballistic_missile_eq_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = ballistic_missile_equipment_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ballistic_missile_eq_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 6 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_cv_small_plane_airframe_2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_cv_small_plane_airframe_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_cv_small_plane_airframe_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = cv_small_plane_airframe_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_cv_small_plane_airframe_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_cv_small_plane_airframe_2 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { cv_small_plane_airframe_2 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_cv_small_plane_airframe_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@cv_small_plane_airframe_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 6 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_cv_small_plane_airframe_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = cv_small_plane_airframe_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_cv_small_plane_airframe_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_cv_fighter_eq_cw2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 9 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_cv_fighter_eq_cw2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_cv_fighter_eq_cw2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_cv_fighter_eq_cw2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = cv_fighter_equipment_cw2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}

			limit = {

				check_variable = { dd_idx = 11 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_cv_fighter_eq_cw5 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_cv_fighter_eq_cw5 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }

				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }

			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_guided_missile_eq_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@guided_missile_equipment_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }

				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 13 }

dd_buy_all_guided_missile_eq_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 14 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_guided_missile_eq_2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_guided_missile_eq_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_guided_missile_eq_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = guided_missile_equipment_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_guided_missile_eq_cw = {

		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 16 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_guided_missile_eq_cw > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_guided_missile_eq_cw }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_guided_missile_eq_cw = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = guided_missile_equipment_cw
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_guided_missile_eq_cw = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_guided_missile_eq_cw < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_guided_missile_eq_cw = 17 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { guided_missile_equipment_cw > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_guided_missile_eq_cw > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@guided_missile_equipment_cw }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 16 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_guided_missile_eq_cw }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = guided_missile_equipment_cw
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_guided_missile_eq_cw = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_large_plane_airframe_0 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 19 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_large_plane_airframe_0 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_large_plane_airframe_0 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_large_plane_airframe_0 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = large_plane_airframe_0
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}

		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 21 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_large_plane_airframe_2 > 9 }
			}

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_large_plane_airframe_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {

				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_large_plane_airframe_2 = global.dd_pay_units }

					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }

					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes

dd_sell_all_large_plane_airframe_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_large_plane_airframe_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_large_plane_airframe_2 = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { large_plane_airframe_2 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_large_plane_airframe_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@large_plane_airframe_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 21 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_large_plane_airframe_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = large_plane_airframe_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_large_plane_airframe_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_strat_bomber_eq_cw1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 24 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_strat_bomber_eq_cw1 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_strat_bomber_eq_cw1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_strat_bomber_eq_cw1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = strat_bomber_equipment_cw1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes

dd_sell_all_strat_bomber_eq_cw3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_strat_bomber_eq_cw3 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_strat_bomber_eq_cw3 = 24 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { strat_bomber_equipment_cw3 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_strat_bomber_eq_cw3 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@strat_bomber_equipment_cw3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 26 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_strat_bomber_eq_cw3 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = strat_bomber_equipment_cw3
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_strat_bomber_eq_cw3 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_strat_bomber_eq_cw6 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 29 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_strat_bomber_eq_cw6 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_strat_bomber_eq_cw6 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_strat_bomber_eq_cw6 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = strat_bomber_equipment_cw6
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_medium_plane_airframe_3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 34 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_medium_plane_airframe_3 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_medium_plane_airframe_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_medium_plane_airframe_3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = medium_plane_airframe_3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_tac_bomber_eq_cw1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 36 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_tac_bomber_eq_cw1 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_tac_bomber_eq_cw1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_tac_bomber_eq_cw1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = tac_bomber_equipment_cw1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_tac_bomber_eq_cw1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_tac_bomber_eq_cw1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_tac_bomber_eq_cw1 = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { tac_bomber_equipment_cw1 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_tac_bomber_eq_cw1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@tac_bomber_equipment_cw1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 36 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_tac_bomber_eq_cw1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = tac_bomber_equipment_cw1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_tac_bomber_eq_cw1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_tac_bomber_eq_cw4 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 39 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_tac_bomber_eq_cw4 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_tac_bomber_eq_cw4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_tac_bomber_eq_cw4 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = tac_bomber_equipment_cw4
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 41 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_nuclear_missile_eq_2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_nuclear_missile_eq_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_nuclear_missile_eq_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {

					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }

				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes

			}

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@nuclear_missile_equipment_2 }

						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }

dd_buy_all_recon_uav_eq_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 44 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_recon_uav_eq_2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_recon_uav_eq_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_recon_uav_eq_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = recon_uav_equipment_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }

dd_sell_all_sam_missile_eq_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_sam_missile_eq_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_sam_missile_eq_2 = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { sam_missile_equipment_2 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_sam_missile_eq_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@sam_missile_equipment_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 46 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_sam_missile_eq_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = sam_missile_equipment_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_sam_missile_eq_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_small_plane_airframe_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_1 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { small_plane_airframe_1 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@small_plane_airframe_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 48 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = small_plane_airframe_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_small_plane_airframe_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_small_plane_airframe_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 49 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_small_plane_airframe_2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_small_plane_airframe_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_small_plane_airframe_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = small_plane_airframe_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 51 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_small_plane_airframe_4 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_small_plane_airframe_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_small_plane_airframe_4 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = small_plane_airframe_4
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_small_plane_airframe_4 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 51 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_small_plane_airframe_4 > 9 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { treasury = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
			dd_pay_front_seller = yes
			set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 10 }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_small_plane_airframe_4 = 10 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = small_plane_airframe_4
				amount = 10
				producer = ROOT
			}
			dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
			dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
		}
}

dd_sell_all_small_plane_airframe_4 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_4 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_4 = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { small_plane_airframe_4 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_4 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@small_plane_airframe_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 51 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_4 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = small_plane_airframe_4
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_small_plane_airframe_4 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_small_plane_airframe_4 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_4 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_4 = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { small_plane_airframe_4 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_4 > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 51 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_4 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = 10 }
		dd_post_listing = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
			dd_enqueue_seller = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = small_plane_airframe_4
					amount = -10
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_small_plane_airframe_4 = 10 }
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
			else = {
				dd_unpost_lot = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {

			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_small_plane_airframe_4 > 0 }

	}

	}
