	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { fighter_equipment_cw1 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@fighter_equipment_cw1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 53 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = fighter_equipment_cw1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_fighter_eq_cw1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_fighter_eq_cw1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { fighter_equipment_cw1 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 53 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = 10 }
		dd_post_listing = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
			dd_enqueue_seller = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = fighter_equipment_cw1
					amount = -10
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_fighter_eq_cw1 = 10 }
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
			else = {
				dd_unpost_lot = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

dd_ask_up_fighter_eq_cw1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { fighter_equipment_cw1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 < 999 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 = 1 }
		dd_refresh_buy_slots = yes
	}
}

dd_ask_down_fighter_eq_cw1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { fighter_equipment_cw1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 > 1 }
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw1 = 1 }
		dd_refresh_buy_slots = yes
	}
}

dd_buy_all_fighter_eq_cw2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 54 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_fighter_eq_cw2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_fighter_eq_cw2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_fighter_eq_cw2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = fighter_equipment_cw2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_fighter_eq_cw2 = {

dd_sell_all_fighter_eq_cw4 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw4 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw4 = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { fighter_equipment_cw4 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw4 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@fighter_equipment_cw4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 56 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw4 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = fighter_equipment_cw4
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_fighter_eq_cw4 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

					}

dd_buy_all_fighter_eq_cw5b = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 59 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_fighter_eq_cw5b > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_fighter_eq_cw5b }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_fighter_eq_cw5b = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = fighter_equipment_cw5b
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_fighter_eq_cw6 = {

		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw6 = 22 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { fighter_equipment_cw6 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw6 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@fighter_equipment_cw6 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 61 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_fighter_eq_cw6 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = fighter_equipment_cw6
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_fighter_eq_cw6 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_strike_uav_eq_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 64 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_strike_uav_eq_1 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_strike_uav_eq_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_strike_uav_eq_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = strike_uav_equipment_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_heli_eq_2 = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { transport_heli_equipment_2 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_heli_eq_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@transport_heli_equipment_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 66 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_transport_heli_eq_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = transport_heli_equipment_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_transport_heli_eq_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}

		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_1 = 8 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { transport_plane_equipment_1 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_1 > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 68 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = 10 }
		dd_post_listing = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
			dd_enqueue_seller = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = transport_plane_equipment_1
					amount = -10
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_transport_plane_eq_1 = 10 }
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
			else = {
				dd_unpost_lot = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

dd_ask_up_transport_plane_eq_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { transport_plane_equipment_1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_1 < 999 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_1 = 1 }
		dd_refresh_buy_slots = yes
	}
}

dd_ask_down_transport_plane_eq_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { transport_plane_equipment_1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_1 > 1 }
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_1 = 1 }
		dd_refresh_buy_slots = yes
	}
}

dd_buy_all_transport_plane_eq_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 69 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_transport_plane_eq_2 > 9 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_transport_plane_eq_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_transport_plane_eq_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = transport_plane_equipment_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_transport_plane_eq_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 69 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 9 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_transport_plane_eq_2 > 9 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { treasury = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 10 }
			dd_pay_front_seller = yes
			set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 10 }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_transport_plane_eq_2 = 10 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = transport_plane_equipment_2
				amount = 10
				producer = ROOT
			}
			dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
			dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
		}
}

dd_sell_all_transport_plane_eq_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_2 = 9 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { transport_plane_equipment_2 > 9 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@transport_plane_equipment_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 10 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 69 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_transport_plane_eq_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 10 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = transport_plane_equipment_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_transport_plane_eq_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_floating_harbor_eq_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 1 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_floating_harbor_eq_1 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_floating_harbor_eq_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_floating_harbor_eq_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = floating_harbor_equipment_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_repair_ship_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_repair_ship_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_repair_ship_2 = 13 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { repair_ship_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_repair_ship_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@repair_ship_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 3 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_repair_ship_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = repair_ship_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_repair_ship_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_carrier_conversion_bb = 54 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_carrier_conversion_bb > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_carrier_conversion_bb > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_carrier_conversion_bb }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 5 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_carrier_conversion_bb }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = ship_hull_carrier_conversion_bb
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_conversion_bb = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_carrier_conversion_ca = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 6 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_conversion_ca > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_conversion_ca }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_conversion_ca = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_carrier_conversion_ca
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_ship_hull_carrier_conversion_ca = {

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_escort_carrier = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = escort_carrier
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_escort_carrier = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 8 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_escort_carrier > 0 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { treasury = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
			dd_pay_front_seller = yes
			set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 1 }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_escort_carrier = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = escort_carrier
				amount = 1
				producer = ROOT
			}
			dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
			dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
		}
}

dd_sell_all_escort_carrier = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_escort_carrier < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_escort_carrier = 30 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { escort_carrier > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_escort_carrier > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@escort_carrier }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 8 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_escort_carrier }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = escort_carrier
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_escort_carrier = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_escort_carrier = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_escort_carrier < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_escort_carrier = 30 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { escort_carrier > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_escort_carrier > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 8 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_escort_carrier }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = 1 }
		dd_post_listing = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
			dd_enqueue_seller = yes

					amount = -1
				}

				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}

			}
		}
	}
}

dd_buy_all_carrier_3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 11 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_carrier_3 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_carrier_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_carrier_3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = carrier_3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_carrier_4 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_carrier_4 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_carrier_4 = 120 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { carrier_4 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_carrier_4 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@carrier_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 13 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_carrier_4 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = carrier_4
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_carrier_4 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_mega_carrier = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 14 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_mega_carrier > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_mega_carrier }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_mega_carrier = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = mega_carrier
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_mega_carrier = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 16 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_mega_carrier > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_mega_carrier }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_mega_carrier = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_mega_carrier
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_ship_hull_mega_carrier = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_mega_carrier < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_mega_carrier = 93 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_mega_carrier > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_mega_carrier > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_mega_carrier }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 16 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_mega_carrier }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = ship_hull_mega_carrier
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_mega_carrier = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_modern_carrier = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_modern_carrier < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_modern_carrier = 130 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { modern_carrier > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_modern_carrier > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@modern_carrier }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 18 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_modern_carrier }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = modern_carrier
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_modern_carrier = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_carrier_cw1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 19 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_cw1 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_cw1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_cw1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_carrier_cw1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_carrier_cw3 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_carrier_cw3 = 76 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_carrier_cw3 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_carrier_cw3 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_carrier_cw3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 21 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_carrier_cw3 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = ship_hull_carrier_cw3
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_cw3 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_carrier_cw6 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 24 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_cw6 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_cw6 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_cw6 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_carrier_cw6
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_light_cruiser_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_cruiser_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_cruiser_1 = 36 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { light_cruiser_1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_cruiser_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@light_cruiser_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 26 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_light_cruiser_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = light_cruiser_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_cruiser_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_cruiser_panzerschiff = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 29 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_cruiser_panzerschiff > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_cruiser_panzerschiff }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_cruiser_panzerschiff = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_cruiser_panzerschiff
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_light_cruiser_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_cruiser_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_cruiser_2 = 37 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { light_cruiser_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_light_cruiser_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@light_cruiser_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 31 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_light_cruiser_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = light_cruiser_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_cruiser_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_light_cruiser_3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 34 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_cruiser_3 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_light_cruiser_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_cruiser_3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = light_cruiser_3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_ship_hull_torpedo_cruiser = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_torpedo_cruiser < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_torpedo_cruiser = 34 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_torpedo_cruiser > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_torpedo_cruiser > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_torpedo_cruiser }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 36 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_torpedo_cruiser }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = ship_hull_torpedo_cruiser
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_torpedo_cruiser = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_light_cruiser_4 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 39 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_cruiser_4 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_light_cruiser_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_light_cruiser_4 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = light_cruiser_4
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_amphib_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 42 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_amphib_1 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_amphib_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_amphib_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_amphib_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_amphib_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 44 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_amphib_2 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_amphib_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_amphib_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_amphib_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_ship_hull_amphib_2 = {

dd_sell_all_ship_hull_amphib_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_amphib_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_amphib_2 = 45 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_amphib_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_amphib_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_amphib_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 44 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_amphib_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = ship_hull_amphib_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_amphib_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_amphib_5 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 49 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_amphib_5 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_amphib_5 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_amphib_5 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_amphib_5
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_battle_cruiser_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_battle_cruiser_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_battle_cruiser_1 = 50 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { battle_cruiser_1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_battle_cruiser_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@battle_cruiser_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 51 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_battle_cruiser_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = battle_cruiser_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_battle_cruiser_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {

				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_battleship_1 = global.dd_pay_units }

					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
