dd_buy_all_SH_battleship_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 54 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_SH_battleship_1 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_SH_battleship_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_SH_battleship_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = SH_battleship_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_SH_battleship_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_SH_battleship_1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_SH_battleship_1 = 170 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { SH_battleship_1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_SH_battleship_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@SH_battleship_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 54 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_SH_battleship_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = SH_battleship_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_SH_battleship_1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 56 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_heavy_2 > 0 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { treasury = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
			dd_pay_front_seller = yes
			set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 1 }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_heavy_2 = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = ship_hull_heavy_2
				amount = 1
				producer = ROOT
			}
			dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
			dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
		}
}

dd_sell_all_ship_hull_heavy_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 = 60 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_heavy_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_heavy_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 56 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = ship_hull_heavy_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_heavy_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_ship_hull_heavy_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 = 60 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_heavy_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 56 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = 1 }
		dd_post_listing = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
			dd_enqueue_seller = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_heavy_2
					amount = -1
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_heavy_2 = 1 }
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
			else = {
				dd_unpost_lot = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

dd_ask_up_ship_hull_heavy_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_heavy_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 < 999 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 = 1 }
		dd_refresh_buy_slots = yes
	}
}

dd_ask_down_ship_hull_heavy_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_heavy_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 > 1 }
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_2 = 1 }
		dd_refresh_buy_slots = yes
	}
}

dd_buy_all_battle_cruiser_2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 57 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_battle_cruiser_2 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_battle_cruiser_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_battle_cruiser_2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = battle_cruiser_2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_heavy_3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 59 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_heavy_3 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_heavy_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_heavy_3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_heavy_3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_ship_hull_heavy_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_3 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_3 = 64 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_heavy_3 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_3 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_heavy_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 59 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_heavy_3 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = ship_hull_heavy_3
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_heavy_3 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_SH_battleship_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_SH_battleship_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_SH_battleship_2 = 260 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { SH_battleship_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_SH_battleship_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@SH_battleship_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 61 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_SH_battleship_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = SH_battleship_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_SH_battleship_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_battleship_4 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 62 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_battleship_4 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_battleship_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_battleship_4 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = battleship_4
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 64 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_modern_battleship > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }

				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_modern_battleship = global.dd_pay_units }

					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }

			}

			dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
		}

dd_sell_all_modern_battleship = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_modern_battleship < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_modern_battleship = 124 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { modern_battleship > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_modern_battleship > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@modern_battleship }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 64 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_modern_battleship }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = modern_battleship
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_modern_battleship = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = destroyer_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_destroyer_1 = global.dd_post_qty }

						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}

					}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_light_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 67 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_light_1 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_light_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_light_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_light_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_ship_hull_light_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_2 = 13 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_light_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_light_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 69 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = ship_hull_light_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_light_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }

		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 70 }

				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_destroyer_3 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }

			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }

				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }

				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_destroyer_3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {

				}

dd_buy_all_destroyer_4 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 72 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_destroyer_4 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_destroyer_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_destroyer_4 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = destroyer_4
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_destroyer_4 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }

			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 1 }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_destroyer_4 = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = destroyer_4
				amount = 1
				producer = ROOT
			}

			dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
		}

dd_sell_all_destroyer_4 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_destroyer_4 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_destroyer_4 = 12 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { destroyer_4 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_destroyer_4 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@destroyer_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 72 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_destroyer_4 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = destroyer_4
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_destroyer_4 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_cw1 = 18 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_light_cw1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_cw1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_light_cw1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 74 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_cw1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_light_cw2 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 75 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_light_cw2 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_light_cw2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_light_cw2 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_light_cw2
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_light_cw4 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 77 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_light_cw4 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_light_cw4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_light_cw4 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_light_cw4
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_ship_hull_light_cw4 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_cw4 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_cw4 = 28 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_light_cw4 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_cw4 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_light_cw4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 77 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_cw4 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = ship_hull_light_cw4
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_light_cw4 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_cw6 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_cw6 = 36 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_light_cw6 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_cw6 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_light_cw6 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 79 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_light_cw6 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_usv_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 80 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_usv_1 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_usv_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_usv_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_usv_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { submarine_1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_submarine_1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@submarine_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 84 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_submarine_1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = submarine_1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}

						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes

					}
				}
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_cruiser_submarine = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 85 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_cruiser_submarine > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_cruiser_submarine }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_cruiser_submarine = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = cruiser_submarine
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_submarine_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_submarine_2 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_submarine_2 = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { submarine_2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_submarine_2 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@submarine_2 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 87 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_submarine_2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = submarine_2
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_submarine_2 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@midget_submarine }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 89 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_midget_submarine }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = midget_submarine
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_midget_submarine = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_cruiser_submarine = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 90 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_cruiser_submarine > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_cruiser_submarine }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_cruiser_submarine = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_cruiser_submarine
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_midget_submarine }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }

				}
			}

			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@submarine_3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }

				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 94 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_submarine_3 }

						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = submarine_3
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}

						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {

					}
				}
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_carrier_submarine = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 95 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_submarine > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_submarine }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_carrier_submarine = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_carrier_submarine
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_sell_all_submarine_4 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_submarine_4 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_submarine_4 = 8 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { submarine_4 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_submarine_4 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@submarine_4 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 97 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_submarine_4 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = submarine_4
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_submarine_4 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_nuclear_missile_submarine = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 100 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_nuclear_missile_submarine > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_nuclear_missile_submarine }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_nuclear_missile_submarine = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = nuclear_missile_submarine
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_nuclear_missile_submarine = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }

dd_sell_all_ship_hull_submarine_cw1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_submarine_cw1 < 1 } }
		set_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_submarine_cw1 = 18 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { ship_hull_submarine_cw1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_submarine_cw1 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_submarine_cw1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_div_q }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 102 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_submarine_cw1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_amt = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_qty = global.dd_pay_units }
				dd_post_listing = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_post_ok = 1 } }
					dd_enqueue_seller = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_enqueue_ok = 1 } }
						set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = 0 }
						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = ship_hull_submarine_cw1
							amount = global.dd_pay_units
						}
						add_to_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_submarine_cw1 = global.dd_post_qty }
						dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
						dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
					}
					else = {
						dd_unpost_lot = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_submarine_diesel_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 103 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_submarine_diesel_1 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_submarine_diesel_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_submarine_diesel_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_submarine_diesel_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}

dd_buy_all_ship_hull_submarine_cw3 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 105 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_submarine_cw3 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_ship_hull_submarine_cw3 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_ship_hull_submarine_cw3 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = ship_hull_submarine_cw3
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}

	}
	if = {

			has_equipment = { ship_hull_submarine_cw5 > 0 }
			check_variable = { dd_my_ask_ship_hull_submarine_cw5 > 0 }
		}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = num_equipment@ship_hull_submarine_cw5 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes

				set_variable = { global.dd_post_cat = 2 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_idx = 107 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_post_price = dd_my_ask_ship_hull_submarine_cw5 }

						subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_post_qty }

					}

dd_buy_all_support_ship_1 = {
		set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_price = global.dd_list_price^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_qty = global.dd_list_qty^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_cat = global.dd_list_cat^dd_i }
		set_temp_variable = { dd_idx = global.dd_list_idx^dd_i }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { dd_cat = 2 }
				check_variable = { dd_idx = 110 }
				check_variable = { dd_price > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < dd_price } }
				check_variable = { dd_qty > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.dd_pool_support_ship_1 > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_pay_amt = dd_price }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = dd_qty }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = global.dd_pool_support_ship_1 }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = 1 }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_n = treasury }
			set_variable = { global.dd_div_d = global.dd_pay_amt }
			dd_floor_div = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_div_q < global.dd_bulk_lots } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots = global.dd_div_q }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_bulk_lots > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_qty = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_pay_amt }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_cost = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				set_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_pay_qty }
				multiply_variable = { global.dd_pay_units = global.dd_bulk_lots }
				subtract_from_variable = { treasury = global.dd_pay_cost }
				dd_pay_bulk = yes
				set_temp_variable = { dd_i = global.dd_active_list }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = global.dd_pay_units }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.dd_pool_support_ship_1 = global.dd_pay_units }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i < 1 } }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_cat^dd_i = -1 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_qty^dd_i = 0 }
					set_variable = { global.dd_list_price^dd_i = 0 }
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = support_ship_1
					amount = global.dd_pay_units
					producer = ROOT
				}
				dd_refresh_market_counts = yes
				dd_refresh_loan_preview = yes
			}
		}
}
